units: Kidd. 6ᵃ האומר חֲרוּפָתִי וכ׳ if one says to a woman, Be my ḥărufah, she is betrothed, for in Judæa they call the betrothed (אֲרוּסָה) ḥărufah.—Esp. שפחה ח׳ (v.
Lev. XIX, 20) a handmaid designated to become the wife of one selected by her master.

<cite ref="Gittin 43a:16">Gitt. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>איזוהי שפחה ח׳</he> (<cite ref="Mishnah Keritot 2:5">Ker. II, 5</cite> only <cite ref="U01728"><he>שפחה</he></cite>) what is the legal condition meant in the law concerning the designated handmaid?—
<cite ref="Tosefta Keritot 1:19">Tosef. Ker. I, 19</cite> <he>אשם ש׳ ח׳</he> the sacrifice due for sleeping with an engaged handmaid.
